You will install, maintain and improve high-quality packaging machines at customer locations across Europe. This position offers a high level of independence, international travel and the opportunity to develop into a technical specialist within a global organisation. The preferred location for this position is the south of the Netherlands, such as North Brabant or Limburg, or the north of Belgium, including East Flanders, Antwerp or Limburg. Installing, assembling and commissioning new machines at customer locations. Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical and automation-related malfunctions. Carrying out machine modifications, upgrades and conversions. Providing both on-site and remote technical support. experienced and internationally oriented Field Service team. Most assignments will take place in the Benelux and Scandinavia. A gross monthly salary between €4,200 and €5,200, depending on your knowledge and experience. A company car, including private use. Paid overtime and 25 annual leave days. What do we expect from you? You are a practical and customer-focused engineer who enjoys working independently in an international service environment. You bring: At least five years of relevant experience as a Field Service Engineer, Mechatronics Engineer or Service Technician. Strong mechanical knowledge, as approximately 60% of the position is mechanically focused. Good electrical and automation knowledge, representing approximately 40% of the role. Experience with industrial machinery, production equipment or packaging machines. Experience with troubleshooting, commissioning and preventive maintenance. Knowledge of Siemens S7 and TIA Portal is an advantage. Knowledge of Bosch Rexroth servo systems is an advantage. Good written and spoken English. A valid driving licence. The willingness to travel regularly throughout the Benelux, Scandinavia and other parts of Europe. Availability to travel up to approximately 75% of your working time by car or aeroplane.
